item.title: visualstudio: Build better applications with Bold BI, a Visual Studio subscriber benefit from Syncfusion
item.description:
The post says Visual Studio subscribers can use Bold BI from Syncfusion to add dashboards and data visualization to applications. It frames this as a way to surface connected data inside an app for end users.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: dotnet: Blazor Welcomes Open-Source Contributions from Syncfusion
item.description:
Microsoft and Syncfusion are collaborating on Blazor via a free open-source component toolkit, framework contributions, and developer tooling. The post says these contributions are now part of the Blazor ecosystem.

  • Source: .NET
